ideal: Alert: Meta rose 6.55% while the S&P 500 fell 0.46%, and no filing explains it yet. Amazon filed an 8-K (current-events report) under item 5.02, which covers director or officer changes, with the link. The Microsoft proxy filing is left out.

verdicts.note: Covers both events with correct numbers, explains what an 8-K and item 5.02 mean in plain words, and skips the proxy filing.
verdicts.answer:
Meta Platforms rose 6.55% while the S&P 500 fell 0.46%. No filing explains it yet.
Amazon filed an 8-K, a report on current events. It's under item 5.02, which covers changes to its directors or top officers or their pay: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1018724/000101872426000036/amzn-20260908.htm

verdicts.note: Accurate, but it doesn't say what an 8-K is or what this one covers, so she can't tell why it matters.

Amazon filed an 8‑K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1018724/000101872426000036/amzn-20260908.htm)
